openwrt_wiki.Beschreibung: TP-Link CPE510/520 is a 5 GHz outdoor access point similar to Ubiquiti NanoStations. ... built-in 13 dBi 2x2 dual-polarized directional MIMO antenna with a beamwidth of 45° (H-Plane) and 30° (E-Plane).
openwrt_wiki.Supported Versions: v1 supported: v1.1 UN ,... / v2 supported: ... / v3 supported: v3.20 UN, ...; version can check by 'strings /dev/mtd2'
openwrt_wiki.Installation: Stock-Weboberfläche https://192.168.0.254 (admin/admin), factory-Image als factory.bin unter System > Firmware Update hochladen; Dateiname höchstens 68 Zeichen; danach 192.168.1.1
openwrt_wiki.Opening the case: Remove the cap at the lower back of the device. Underneath the sticker which labels GND, LAN0, LAN1 and RESET in the lower left and lower right corner, there are two screws to remove. Afterwards, you can slide the whole board out of the case by applying some force.
openwrt_wiki.Serial: J1 is located near the LEDs on the board. Starting from left to right: TX, RX, GND, 3.3V. TTL voltage, 115200 bps, 8N1. Note: CPE510 v1.1 cannot direct flash dump, need desolder if you need to dump.
openwrt_wiki.PoE Passthrough: GPIO 20 (high) aktiviert PoE Passthrough; dauerhaft per gpio_switch 'poe_passthrough' in /etc/config/system
openwrt_wiki.Bootloader: SafeLoader, Passwort admin; Menü Boot / Upgrade Firmware (TFTP, Serial) / Backup / Restore / Set Password / Reboot
openwrt_wiki.Flash Layout: CPE510 v1.1 (waiting someone verify): SPI NOR 8 MiB: u-boot 128 KiB | partition-table 64 KiB | info 64 KiB | config 192 KiB | art 64 KiB | firmware 7.5 MiB
openwrt_wiki.Debricking: PC 192.168.0.100, Originalfirmware als recovery.bin per TFTP, Reset beim Einschalten halten; Switch zwischen PC und CPE empfohlen
openwrt_wiki.Hardware mods: Omni-directional antenna mod (für CPE210 gemacht, für CPE510 vermutlich möglich), Freifunk-Forum 594/77

openwrt_git_lna.titel: ath79: enable LNA for all ar9344 TPLink CPE devices
openwrt_git_lna.text: The TPLink CPE devices CPE210/CPE510 based on ar9344 have a build-in Low Noise Amplifier on both of the 2x2 mimo rx chains. ... improves the RX sensitivity by about 20dB. Tested on CPE510 v2 & v3.
